articles.title: 'Sabka Malik Ek': Watch Army Chief Gen Upendra Dwivedi reveal reason why India didn't strike Pakistan during Namaz in Op Sindoor
articles.summary: Army Chief General Upendra Dwivedi revealed Indian forces deliberately paused strikes during Operation Sindoor. This strategic decision was made to avoid targeting terror camps during prayer hours, showcasing the Indian Army's calibrated approach. It emphasizes ethical considerations and precision, even against adversaries, reflecting a commitment to minimizing collateral damage and respecting religious sentiments.

articles.title: Taiwan spotted Chinese warplanes as Xi met opposition leader in Beijing
articles.summary: Taiwan's defence ministry reported spotting 16 Chinese warplanes near the island on Friday. articles.title: Ethanol in diesel generators: India’s next practical step towards energy security
articles.summary: India's ethanol blending programme showcases the government's strategic vision for Atmanirbhar Bharat, significantly reducing dependence on imported crude oil. This initiative bolsters energy security, promotes self-reliance, and offers substantial economic and environmental benefits. It reflects a long-term policy commitment towards sustainable growth and national independence, crucial for India's strategic autonomy.

articles.title: Foreign Secretary Misri wraps up US visit with talks on nuclear cooperation and LPG exports
articles.summary: India's Foreign Secretary Vikram Misri met with the US Energy Secretary to deepen energy cooperation. Discussions focused on expanding nuclear power initiatives, exploring new avenues like coal gasification, and enhancing LPG exports. This strategic dialogue underscores India's commitment to energy security and diversification, strengthening vital bilateral ties with the US across crucial energy sectors, reflecting a forward-looking foreign policy.
